meta.name: security-scan
meta.description: 对进入系统的文件或 URL 执行安全与合规扫描，输出 pass/reject 判定与扫描报告，作为所有文档处理的强制前置关卡。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描文件与链接，输出安全放行或拒绝的判定
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要先审文件或链接是否安全再决定放行
copy.tagline_en: Scan files and links, return pass or reject verdicts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to vet files or links for safety before approving access

howto.what: 任何文件或链接进入系统前会先被它扫描，给出 pass 或 reject 判定和一份扫描报告，并留下追踪 ID 供留痕。
howto.when: 当文件或 URL 进入系统、准备做文档处理时触发；它是流水线的第一道闸门，任何文件进入前都必须经它把关。

say.text: 帮我扫描一下这个文件：/path/report.pdf
say.note: 返回 pass/reject 判定和扫描报告

say.text: 检查这个链接是否合规：https://xxx
say.note: 会先解析域名再比对黑名单

say.text: 用我指定的策略集扫描这个文件（policy_ref）
say.note: 替换默认的合规规则集

howto.what_en: Before any file or link enters the system it is scanned and given a pass or reject verdict plus a scan report, and a trace ID is written for the record.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a file or URL enters the system and is about to be processed; it is the first gate in the pipeline and every file must pass through it first.

say_en.note: Returns a pass/reject verdict and a scan report

say_en.text: Check whether this URL is compliant: https://xxx
say_en.note: Parses the domain first, then checks the blacklist

say_en.text: Scan this file with my own policy set (policy_ref)
say_en.note: Overrides the default compliance rule set
